name: trade-tracker
description: A local-first swing-trade risk calculator and position tracker.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/data && cp index.html curate.html curate.js styles.css app.js engine.js compound.js guide.js motion.js icons.js qr.js gist-sync.js favicon.svg robots.txt llms.txt dist/ && cp data/guide.json data/movers.json dist/data/ && if [ -f data/daily-scan.json ]; then cp data/daily-scan.json dist/data/; fi && cp docs/promo/og-1200x630.png dist/og.png && sed "s/__LASTMOD__/$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)/" sitemap.xml > dist/sitemap.xml
scripts.mockup:themes-board: node docs/mockups/compile-themes-board.mjs && node -e "console.log('Themes board → http://localhost:4173/docs/mockups/themes-board.html?variant=A')" && node serve.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/engine.test.mjs && node tests/qr.test.mjs && node tests/sync.test.mjs && node tests/guide.test.mjs
